content.short: Athletix is an AI-powered sports app on TON that rewards users for predictions and engagement.
content.description: Athletix is an innovative sports-focused application on the TON blockchain that utilizes artificial intelligence to provide users with advanced football predictions and insights. It creates a SocialFi experience where fans are rewarded for their engagement, accurate predictions, and participation in sports-related challenges. By merging sports passion with AI-driven rewards, Athletix provides a unique value proposition for the massive global audience of sports enthusiasts, leveraging the TON network for transparent and efficient distribution of rewards to its active user base.
content.meta: Predict and earn with Athletix, the AI sports app on TON. For the true fans, on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
